references.text: The plan to kill the heir reflects the story of Joseph, where his brothers planned to kill him but ended up selling him.
Shows a parallel to the evil men's plans against the rightful heir, mirroring the evil leaders' plans against Jesus.
Luke's parallel account of the event in Matthew, where the vineyard workers plan to kill the heir.
Mark's version of the parable, which also tells of the vineyard workers planning to kill the heir.
